notes: The potentiometer is a breadboard trimmer: two outer legs on one side of the centre gap and the wiper leg on the other side. In the picture the wiper side is the upper half, which is bank 'b' in the catalogue naming. The outer-leg side is the lower half, which is bank 't'.
Exact rows are estimated from the image. The outer legs are in row e with the wires in row d of the same column strips. The wiper leg is in row g with the yellow wire in row h of the same strip.
Left outer leg (col 10) goes to GND and right outer leg (col 12) goes to 5V. The manual allows either assignment because the outer pins are interchangeable apart from the direction of rotation.
The black wire goes to the second GND pin on the Uno power header, which is called GND.2 here. GND.1 would be equivalent.
The manual lists no other hardware. The USB cable for serial monitor and power is not modelled.
